newsitem.title: USA: GOLF-COUPLES, JANZEN PICKED FOR U.S. RYDER CUP TEAM.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-COUPLES, JANZEN PICKED FOR U.S. RYDER CUP TEAM.

text.p: Fred Couples and Lee Janzen were named on Monday to round out the 12-man U.S. Ryder Cup team that will try to win back the cup from Europe next month at Valderrama Golf Club in southern Spain.

Captain Tom Kite -- who said he seriously considered a dozen players, including himself, for the two spots -- said he chose Couples for his Ryder Cup experience and Janzen because he has played well recently, especially in the just-ended PGA Championship here.

Couples, a veteran of four Cup campaigns, and Janzen, the 1993 U.S. Open champion who played on the 1993 team, join 10 other players who played their way onto the team by earning points in tournaments since January 1996.
Kite said he picked Couples, 37, because he considers him one of the most talented players on the American tour.

He also said Couples is such a versatile player that he can be paired easily with a number of other players in Ryder Cup competition, which involves two types of two-man team play as well as singles matches.
The captain said he selected Janzen, 32, partly because of the way he played in the PGA Championship at Winged Foot Golf Club -- especially on Sunday when Kite and Janzen played together.
"He put on a good, strong finish yesterday in front of the captain," Kite said of Janzen, who shot a solid one-under-par 69 on Sunday to finish fourth in the PGA, just one shot ahead of Kite.
Kite said one of the main reasons he did not pick himself was that he felt the demands of being captain may affect his ability to play well in the three-day event September 26-28.
